integrity: All claims are supported by an explicit symbolic proof; finite calculations are independent checks, not proofs of the general statement. Publication priority and independent verification have not been established.
scientific_limitations: General annihilator rigidity holds over arbitrary characteristic-two fields under independent nonzero natural-basis squares. The five-case table and labeled census are for two-dimensional algebras over finite characteristic-two fields only; higher-dimensional dependent-square cases and imperfect-field counts remain outside scope.
title: Characteristic-two local Rota–Baxter phase diagram for evolution algebras
